# IInflightAssetTracking
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IInflightAssetTracking.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC165

**Title:**
IInflightAssetTracking

Generic interface for contracts that track inflight assets during bridging operations

Implements method to track assets that are currently being bridged cross-chain


## Functions
### updateInflightAssets

Updates the inflight assets amount when a bridge operation is executed

Called by authorized bridge components when assets are transferred cross-chain


```solidity
function updateInflightAssets(uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of assets that are now in-flight|


## Events
### InflightAssetsUpdated
Emitted when inflight assets amount is updated


```solidity
event InflightAssetsUpdated(uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The new amount of in-flight assets|
